summary: Join our KPI Analytics and Performance Dashboards Training Course to gain essential skills in data visualization and performance measurement for business growth
lede: KPI training helps analytics professionals, business intelligence specialists and managers select meaningful measures and build dashboards for performance decisions. It covers aligning indicators with strategic objectives, designing clear visualizations and interactive drill-downs, and integrating data with quality checks and refresh routines. Learners also explore forecasting and alerts to identify performance issues and communicate findings for action.
audienceIntro: This course serves analytics professionals, business intelligence specialists, and managers responsible for organizational performance measurement who need to elevate their dashboard design and KPI analytics capabilities.
modules: Performance Measurement Strategy and Business Context
KPI Selection and Metrics Framework Design
Advanced Visualization Techniques and Dashboard Design
prerequisites: Participants should have basic experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, and familiarity with database concepts. Previous exposure to business intelligence platforms is helpful but not required. Understanding of basic statistical concepts and organizational performance measurement is recommended.
